11-year-old FM Aarit Kapil played a great game with the Black pieces to take down GM Shyaam Nikhil P in Round 5 of the Chola Chess GM Open 2026 - after holding 4 Grandmasters to draws in the previous 4 rounds! We caught up with Aarit for a detailed interview after the game.
Video: ChessBase India
Interview: Devansh Singh
